subject: Social Media
title: Can We Redesign the System?
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Can We Redesign the System?.

hook.text: Wikipedia runs on donations, not ads. It's the 5th most visited site. Proof that another model works.

buildup.text: Alternative models exist: subscriptions, public funding, cooperatives. Each removes the need to capture attention.

discovery.text: The BBC operates without ads. Public media serves citizens, not advertisers. Attention isn't the product.

twist.text: But ad-funded platforms dominate because free always wins adoption. Changing the model means changing user behavior.

climax.text: Regulation, design ethics, and public alternatives together could shift the system. No single fix is enough.

punchline.text: The system was designed. It can be redesigned.

quiz.question: What model does Wikipedia prove can work at scale?
